matching: same-class maximum-total-IoU one-to-one; strictly positive IoU; dummy unmatched assignments
matched_credit: matched IoU minus mean quality for the same GT over all eight responses; missing quality is zero; no standard-deviation scaling
class_stop_credit: negative unmatched-GT fraction within the class, at its last actually generated box_end
eos_credit: negative missing-GT count from entirely absent classes divided by all evaluable GT, at an actually generated terminal EOS
initialization: same original-ID SFT adapter as the global-reward baseline; never initialize from the RL baseline
